title: Which Country Matches Your Personality?
summary: Ten lifestyle choices reveal whether your personality most closely matches Italy, Japan, Australia or Sweden.

landing.intro: Your everyday choices may point to one country that fits you better than the rest. Ten quick questions reveal your closest match.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment quiz is adapted from the linked Times of India country-personality challenge. Each choice adds a signal for Italy, Japan, Australia or Sweden.

Choose the answer that feels most natural rather than the one that sounds most impressive. Your strongest overall pattern determines the final country match.

The result describes a playful lifestyle archetype, not nationality, ancestry, citizenship, cultural identity or a relocation recommendation. Source-question concepts and images are reproduced from Times of India with the permission stated by the site owner commissioning this quiz.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten quick questions about your habits and preferences.
Choose the option that feels most like you without overthinking it.
Reveal the country and personality style matched to your choices.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not determine nationality, identity or where anyone should live.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten choices have created a clear country-personality match.

profile-1.title: You Match Italy
profile-1.copy: Warmth, expression and the pleasure of shared moments run through your choices. You value beauty and tradition, but you also know that life is better when there is time for conversation, food and the people who matter.

profile-2.title: You Match Japan
profile-2.copy: Your answers favour care, meaning and attention to detail. You are drawn to experiences that combine tradition with fresh thinking, and you appreciate calm spaces where small rituals can make an ordinary day feel intentional.

profile-3.title: You Match Australia
profile-3.copy: Open space, easy conversation and a willingness to try something new shape your result. You prefer life with room to move, people who do not take themselves too seriously and plans that can become adventures.

profile-4.title: You Match Sweden
profile-4.copy: Balance, simplicity and quiet quality stand out across your choices. You value personal space without losing connection, and you are happiest when comfort, nature and thoughtful design work together.
